textwithimage.text:
8th Generation Intel® Core™ Processor

The COMBox-V8, a fanless industrial BoxPC, is a robust and versatile solution designed for industrial applications, catering to the demands of Smart Manufacturing and Industrial IoT. At its core lies the power of the 8th Generation Intel® Core™ Processor, offering exceptional performance with up to Quad Core clock speeds of 4.4 GHz and 8 MB cache. This processing prowess, combined with fast DDR4-2400 Dual-Channel Memory supporting up to 64 GByte, ensures seamless handling of both high-demanding applications and AI-driven solutions.

The COMBox-V8 fanless industrial BoxPC boasts high-speed I/O capabilities, including 2x GBit ETH and 4x USB3.1 Gen 2 (10 GBit/s) ports, facilitating efficient data transfer and connectivity. Its two independent high-resolution display outputs further enhance its versatility. The system also offers flexible storage configurations, accommodating M.2 NVMe and 2.5” SSD options.

With a fanless design and low power dissipation, the COMBox-V8 is well-suited for challenging industrial environments. Its modular design, expansion options via M.2 and Mini PCIe, and customizable sheet metal chassis provide an optimal platform for tailored configurations and adaptations. Additionally, the integration of Intel Core 8th generation mobile processors ensures high computing and graphics performance, making it suitable for a wide range of industrial applications.

The COMBox-V8 fanless industrial BoxPC is a dependable choice for FPGA engineers seeking industrial-grade computing solutions, offering reliability, performance, and adaptability for demanding industrial scenarios.

text.text:
Features

  • Quad Core 4.4 GHz Processor: High-performance 8th Generation Intel® Core™ Processor with quad-core architecture for robust computing.
  • Up to 64 GByte DDR4 Memory: Dual-channel DDR4-2400 memory support, providing ample memory capacity for data-intensive applications.
  • High-Speed I/O: Fast data transfer with 2x GBit ETH and 4x USB3.1 Gen 2 (10 GBit/s) ports.
  • Versatile Display Outputs: Two independent high-resolution DisplayPort outputs for flexible display configurations.
  • Customizable Storage: Individual mass storage configurations with M.2 NVMe and 2.5” SSD options, accommodating varying storage needs.
